item.title: Other Useful Maps for Planning in the Indian Himalaya
item.description: A guide to some lesser-known but genuinely useful map resources for the Indian Himalaya — from Harish Kapadia’s expedition sketches to Depi Chaudhry’s trekking maps and the Pahar archive.

item.title: Topographic and Trekking Maps of the Indian Himalaya
item.description: A guide to the main topographic map series covering the Indian Himalaya and how to get them onto your phone.

item.title: 3 Helpful Features to Have While Hiking with OsmAnd, Especially in India
item.description: Three features that significantly improve hiking with OsmAnd in India - a dedicated hiking rendering profile, offline Survey of India topo maps, and a large collection of raster map sources including satellite imagery and Strava heatmaps.

item.title: Survey of India Topo Maps on OsmAnd
item.description: How to get offline Survey of India 1:50,000 topographic maps working as an overlay on OsmAnd.
